title: Activities now open in order
items: 🔒 Each activity opens only after you finish the one before it on the same day. For example, Activity 5.2 opens after Activity 5.1 is finished.
An activity is finished when every step is done and you have pressed Check my answers.
A day still opens only when every activity of the day before is finished. Practice missions and the Workspace stay open.
trainer: Trainer accounts can still open every activity. No Code.gs change is needed.

title: Shared activities open ready to submit
items: 🤝 When a teammate shares an activity, opening it takes you straight to the activity (the demo video is skipped; watch it any time with the Demo video button).
Your worksheet is filled in with your teammate's answers and their finished steps, and the lab shows Submit now.
If you already typed your own answers, the lab asks before replacing them.
trainer: Copied steps are logged with the copied answers, and copies are still flagged ⧉ COPIED on the board. Seat-specific answers (N.4) are still not copied.
Copying steps needs the updated Code.gs: paste it, run setup, and deploy a new version.

title: Team rooms, shared answers and update notices
items: 👥 Team is now one room for your team: Chat, Members and Shared answers. Messages arrive within seconds, and you see when a teammate is typing.
Trainer announcements are pinned at the top of your team room.
🤝 Share my answers (above an activity's worksheet) shares your answers with your team, on the days your trainer turns sharing on.

When a teammate shares the activity you are on, the lab offers to fill in your worksheet with their answers. Your trainer sees every copy. Steps are never copied: run the commands on your own terminal.
When every answer is filled in, the lab tells you the activity is ready to submit.
The lab now tells you when it has been updated. Your work is saved first, and you can finish what you are doing before updating.
trainer: Trainer board > 👥 Teams: drag trainees between teams, rename teams, or balance the class into mixed teams.
Settings > Answer Sharing turns sharing on per day. Copies show as ⧉ COPIED on the board and in the Copies tab.
Paste the new Code.gs, run setup and deploy a new version to switch this on.
